label: Salted lassi
note: Made from set dahi, with its mesophilic starter, not from thermophilic yoghurt; the curd is broken up and salt and cumin go in after fermentation

about.text: Lassi is a yogurt–based beverage with a smoothie-like consistency. The word 'lassi' for the drink is a borrowing from Hindi, first attested in 1882; its ultimate origin is unclear, and has been suggested as derived ultimately from Sanskrit lasya (stickiness) or rasah (juice).
